items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Well, there was a band on a color band called Sweet Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Oh, is that right? I didn't know. Anything else you can remember when you were a kid? Any of the first music you ever heard aside from home? Were there other bands around?
Well, there was a band on a color band called Sweet Buddy Petit. There was, Papa Lane used to call his band the Reliance band. And then we played on a streetcar, Emmet Rogers.
Oh yeah, tell me about that.
